description: This file provides a WebSocket client helper for tracking order status updates in a food delivery frontend application. It includes functions to derive WebSocket URLs based on environment variables and a factory function to create and manage WebSocket connections, including subscribing to order updates.

methods.name: deriveWsUrl()
methods.description: Determines the WebSocket URL for tracking based on environment variables, with fallback to localhost.

methods.name: createTrackingSocket({ token = null, onMessage = () => {}, onOpen = () => {}, onClose = () => {}, onError = () => {} } = {})
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connection with methods to subscribe to order updates and manage connection lifecycle.
